nom: Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub

avis.texte: I will never understand why brands will get rid of or replace a product that's the only one of its kind with mediocre products that are just like everything else. Such is the case here. They replaced Modern Friction which is the best exfoliation I've ever used (and have been using for 20 years) and such a different formula and mechanism of action than anything else out there, with this standard "microderm abrasion" type scrub. It literally feels like every other one. Meh, really disappointed. I used the Modern Friction with the Drink Up Intensive overnight mask when I wanted to give myself a facial. It was so good.
A great exfoliating face wash, if you have sensitive skin it might be a little too harsh for you.
This polishing scrub is not a suitable alternative to Modern Friction.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I've been skeptical about buying exfoliating face scrub because I've tried a few and was completely disappointed. However, this one truly meets my expectations and has become my favorite facial scrub. It's lightweight and helps reduce my pores, leaving my skin feeling clean and smooth. Thank you Origin!

I have been using this face wash for over 10 years and love it! However their new packaging is flimsy. The last two I have purchased have cracked at the hinge, making it difficult if not impossible to securely close and store. Between this, them not honoring promotions unless I reach out to have it corrected on the back end, and my last order of several products being shipped in 4 separate shipments, all lacking updates, I think I'm done with doing business with them. They just don't seem to be the same, sadly

Rec'd a sample and tried it not realizing you have discontinued modern friction. I broke out and had red rash! Sad that you have also removed Ginzing ultra hydrating energy boosting cream. Do not like the trend where all the fav products are culled!

I should have read the reviews more carefully before purchasing this. When you search the website for Modern Friction, Origins implies that this scrub is essentially the same thing in new packaging. Modern Friction was unique in that it used smooth friction rather than gritty abrasion to polish skin. I'm guessing it was discontinued because people that couldn't be bothered to follow the directions kept on leaving bad reviews, but it really was great if you used it correctly. This new scrub is harsh and gritty, has the oily feel mentioned by other reviewers, and has me breaking out like crazy. Hopefully Origins will eventually come out with a scrub more similar to Modern Friction. If that's what you're looking for, this one definitely is not it.
Please bring back Checks and Balances. It was creamy, not so harsh and left my skin moisturized. This product is like sand and it seems to leave my skin stripped.

avis.titre: Beware: half the size as previous tube
avis.texte: This is my favorite face wash and has been for years. As others have said, the new packaging is top heavy and tips over all the time. It's also only half the size as the previous tube (2.5 fl oz instead of 5), so if you think you are getting a great deal, you have been duped. Aside from those disappointments, at least it's still the product I really like.

avis.titre: Everything I want in a scrub!
avis.texte: I think this is my favorite product here! I'm 70 and my skin has changed but I have always needed exfoliation. After 50 years of using scrub cleansers, this is my favorite. It's lightweight and uses irregular minerals to scrub, not the "beads" in other scrubs that don't seem to get to the blackheads I still have at this age. And it has the added benefit of the same feel as the frothy checks and balances face wash....light and minty!

avis.titre: Not impressed...Please bring back Modern Friction!
avis.texte: Unfortunately and disappointingly, I was not impressed. Modern Friction was the best facial scrub ever. Why hasn't Origins brought this product back after countless years of requests from customers?
I didnt expect it it be light/medium exfoliation, but it still gets the job done if you message your face for a bit. I recommend this with their frothy fash wash, total game changer!! :)

When I saw this, I was so excited and bought some. That didn't last long. I liked that it cleaned my face, but as for a scrub, it didn't really meet my expectations. It was a smaller bottle with a larger price tag and I had to use more product to clean/scrub my face. It was a huge let down, especially since I LOVE checks and balances. I will not be purchasing this again.
This formula is much harsher and not suitable for my skin. Modern Friction was terrific. I used it for years. Please bring it back!

avis.titre: BRING BACK MODERN FRICTION! this product SUCKS!
avis.texte: I have been using checks and balances frothy face wash and modern friction since I was a teenager, and it was the ONLY combo that kept acne and breakouts down. Now that modern friction is no longer available, I bought this hoping it would be a suitable replacement.... NOPE! not only is it a painful experience, but its been making me breakout more than I ever have, and I'm in my 30s! I have tried many different combinations to try to combat the pain and/or the oily feeling after using, and nothing helps with the breakouts. Seriously missing modern friction. I'm so disappointed in you guys for getting rid of a product that worked for one that just sucks.
Bring back Modern Friction! This product is harsh and actually hurts my skin when I use it. I won't buy any more of this.
Bring back modern friction! This is not the same in a bad way.
Too harsh on skin. I use the checks and balances cleanser but the scrub is painful on my skin. Bring back modern friction.

This product does what it is supposed to do and my face feels clean and smooth afterward, but it is an unpleasant washing experience. This feels like sandpaper. I dislike using it and would not recommend it. It is a poor substitute for the previous polishing scrub, Modern Friction, which went on smooth and was a pleasurable washing experience.

avis.titre: DOES NOT WORK AS WELL AS MODERN FRICTION
avis.texte: ORIGINS... Modern Friction was a perfect product to clear clogged pores and soften skin without irritation, why was it discontinued? The C&B Polishing Face Scrub does not work the same magic that Modern Friction did. I have been a loyal Origins customer since the 1990s and each time a beloved product is discontinued - AND THERE HAVE BEEN SO MANY! - it's like losing a close friend. If you're going to discontinue a winning product, replace it with one that is at least as good, if not better. Surely you've heard the age-old adage... "if it ain't broke, don't fix it"? I will not be purchasing this product again. If I could give ZERO stars, I would have.

avis.titre: Not a good replacement for Modern Friction
avis.texte: I have used Modern Friction for years. It's a must have for my skin care. After it was discontinued, I tried this Checks & Balances Scrub; it is not a good replacement at all. Doesn't clean my pores as well, nor does is feel as good after. My face is struggling. Please bring Modern Friction back! Please!
Reminds me of the original Modern Friction that left my skin polished & smooth. I look forward to the days I use this scrub!!

I've used Modern Friction for years. I feel like after a long day, it really cleaned out my pores and exfoliated the dead skin. It has been unavailable for some time now and I tried the Checks and Balances scrub. I used C&B frothy face wash and love it. Unfortunately, I don't feel this scrub is a suitable replacement for Modern Friction, it's a bit of a disappointment. In the last year there has been updates to a number of products and none were for the better.
Please bring back Modern Friction Nature's Gentle Dermabrasion. This scrub is like a sand scratching the skin. I gave it a try few times. Will not repurchase.

I have been using Modern Friction forever. I have sensitive skin and this has been a great exfoliator. I have been rationing what I have left until the new formulation is released, but I am losing hope and about to run out since there is no set release date. Based on some reviews, I am very hesitant to try the Checks and Balances exfoliator even though I use the face wash daily. Please, please, please bring back Modern Friction soon!

Why did modern friction go away !? This product is decent at best but feels harsh somehow on my skin. I also use the ginzing cleanser which is fine but more as a cleanser and not so much for exfoliating. MF was the best product and I used it for many years. Don't understand why such popular and good products are stopped. So much for customer care

avis.titre: Not as good as Modern Friction
avis.texte: This is not a replacement for modern friction unfortunately. Feels too harsh MF was gentler and more effective. Was the only product I have really stayed loyal to even though I cannot spend as much on skincare anymore.

avis.titre: Origins Modern Friction Nature's Gentle Dermabrasion
avis.texte: Where is this product. I can't find it anymore. I have used this for many many years. I cannot use all of your products because I have had some skin reactions from them. This product I do not have any problems with, and this is one of my favorite product that you provide.

avis.titre: It's OK, but not as good as Modern Friction
avis.texte: I used Modern Friction for decades as my go-to for exfoliation cleansing. There was one in the shower and another on my sink. Thinking this was the same thing and I could not find MF anymore, I bought two of these. The beads do the same thing, but there's an ingredient that inflames my skin a bit. It tingles and turns a little bit. I still prefer MF and wish that Origins would bring it back. Why do manufacturers change what has been popular and working? Maybe because they make more money with a new product. I'm 71, and MF never irritated my face all these years. Go figure. I would still recommend this product, but it's not as good as MF was.
Bring back Modern Friction before I switch to another line of facial products. Not sure why you discontinued this product because it was the best for cleansing and lightening the dark spots.

This is the third time in a year I am buying this product, one is for me and the others are for my family. We have dry-combination skin and this exfoliator really works! I have been using Loccitane exfoliator for many years (15+ years) and since they stopped my favorite product I have been searching for a good one that works for my skin. Believe me, I tried many different brands, but none of them worked for me, either making my skin flaky or dry. Ta-da I got Origins as a present, and since then I really love their products! A tip, I find that my skin feels good if use plantscription youth serum or ginzin gel cream after exfoliation.

avis.titre: One of the best deep scrubs
avis.texte: I've used Lancer, I've used other brands with a fine pumice scrub.The Origins version is fantastic. It's expensive for the amount you get. But, you don't need much to get a great, invigorating face scrub that removes everything and leaves your skin smooth and more even. I buy this repeatedly now because of how effective it is, how nice is smells (not a strong scent) and most importantly, the results. Tip: The tube isn't designed well. When you get near the end of the product, there's still a lot left in the corners of the tube. I cut it open and use a small spatula to get lots of remaining product out of it. I keep the cut tube in a plastic baggie so the product doesn't dry out until I've used every last drop. :-)

avis.titre: Ok but maybe not for me
avis.texte: I find this product very abrasive. It smells good though. I think I just don't have a need for it. I would prefer a gentler exfoliating product
this is just ok. but Modern Friction Nature's Gentle Dermabrasion is still #1 Origins exfoliator. When is it going to he back it stock!?? please.
I have been using Origins forever and have never found a decent replacement for "Never A Dull Moment" scrub.... this definitely isn't it! The consistency is thin, granular and highly abrasive.

avis.titre: Please bring back Modern Friction; this is a poor subtitute
avis.texte: I love Origins products, but have to admit I'm in the "why are my favorite products constantly being discontinued" and the "I was told it wasn't discontinued but it's been gone for months" or "it's been out of stock for months and there's no alternative/replacement" camps, which can be very frustrating. Which brings me to this product, which is the closest thing I've found from Origins that is comparable to the Modern Friction cleanser/exfoliator. At first glance, they seem to be similar products - gritty facial exfoliators, which is great. However, this product doesn't foam or lather up, and feels like it's doing little more than mechanical abrasion versus actual pore cleansing. Whenever I use it, it doesn't feel like it's doing much - certainly not nearly the same satisfaction I got when using Modern Friction. To compensate, I combine this with the frothy Checks and Balances cleanser, and that seemed to do the trick somewhat. At that time, I would have rated this product a 3.5 or so. However, as others have mentioned, after using this product for a while, I broke out with a fairly alarming rash all over my neck - my skin was red, itchy at night, and then would peel/flake every other day. At some times, it was painfully burning (though to be fair, it was mild). Still, I've never experienced anything like this from any other beauty/skincare product, and my usual regimen has been in place for years. I can't 100% say this product caused the rash, but it seems like the most like
I love that this is abbrasive. I have extremely sensitive skin and this does not irritate it. Great scrub hust wish is was priced better.

avis.titre: Terrible. Not a suitable replacement for Never a Dull Moment
avis.texte: I've been using Origins products for well over 25 years. I'm a huge fan of Checks & Balancing foaming cleanser. I use nothing else to wash my face. I tried this when Never a Dull Moment was discontinued. Horrible! The frangance is awful & it made my face red & blotchy. I used it once & threw the entire bottle in the trash. Complete waste of money. Now I see they've also discontinued Modern Friction. That was my back up for Never a Dull Moment. Now I can't get either one. Stop discontinuing the products that actually work Origins! I now have no options for an exholiator from you. Very disaapointed.
I love this facial scrub. I just wish it were cheaper. I love the smell and feel after washing my face with it!
I did not like the consistency, feel, or fragrance of the Checks And Balances Face Scrub with Tourmaline. Every other product by Origins I have really enjoyed.

avis.titre: My Go-To Product in the AM
avis.texte: I use a dermatologic (Tretinoin) in the evenings that promotes faster and more resilient cell-turnover, but a side effect can be dry and flaky skin in some spots the next AM. Especially if one sleeps directly on their pillows which can cause some night time moisturizer to rub off; this happens to me quite often. Using this product, for me, even over the gentlederm abrasion product that Origin offers, works best. I am even subscribed to auto-ship because just like all my other skin care products, most of which are *not* Origin brand, this is one product I don't want to be without when I run out.
A nice smelling creamy scrub with a rough gritty exfoliate. Might irritate sensitive skin.

I have been using Origins for 25 years, and have never had an issue! I used this new product and I immediately broke out in a horrible rash. I know it has to be this as this was the only item I added! I would love to have Never a Dull moment back, never had a problem with that product! My skin looks awful, I have a very red rash on my face and chest where I used the product!

I usually use the regular checks and balances but wanted to try this because I usually like the grainy exfoliating scrubs. It was interesting but left kind of a heavy feeling, almost like the Scrubee from Lush (it has Shea butter or something for moisturizing while cleaning). If that's what you're looking for, perfect, I just prefer the squeaky clean feeling I get from the regular C&B so I'll be sticking to that for now. I do have combo skin so maybe that played a role.

It's a little pricey for what you get, but you don't need much to get a really good scrub. It's fine but you can feel the grit. Sorta like the Lancer scrub, if you've ever used that. Doesn't irritate my skin but it definitely cleans off old cells, dry skin, etc.

Wonderful face scrub which is difficult to find. Makes my skin tingle in a good way. Love the refreshing smell and how it feels when I rinse. I only wish it came in a larger size, but a little goes a long way.
I loved the sample I got with a previous order. This is a totally different product. Only used it twice, dried my skin out so much, it became flaky and red.

I love the frothy face wash so I thought I'd give this product a try. First, the grains are extremely fine and I agree with other reviewers that it doesn't feel good on my skin. Very gritty and hard to wash off. But the main issue was my reaction to the product. In the 2 days after use, my skin became extremely dry and scaly and I developed hives and red patches all over my face and neck. Resolved in a few days with my normal cleanser and moisturizer but if you have sensitive skin, proceed with extreme caution here. I have never reacted to a product like this and it's clearly uncommon given the positive reviews, but be careful! I had to toss the product after use because of my reaction.

I was sent a sample of this product and I do like it but I think I'm more in love with the regular frothy face wash. If you are looking for more of a gritty feeling this is your product. It does well exfoliating your face which is nice!
I had been using a very similar product from L'Occitane for many years until it was discontinued. So happy that Origins created a similar product. It's been great for my dry skin. I use it nightly.

I grew up using that harsh gritty apricot scrub, so thank goodness exfoliants have come a long way. Despite using Origins products for decades, I had been using the very pricy Dr. Brandt's because it has a very fine grit that polished my skin gently but effectively, but since trying this Checks and Balances polisher, I'm a convert. It works beautifully and a little tiny bit goes such a long way. I love the smell and the slight tingle afterwards. This stuff is a game changer!

avis.titre: Did not like - not a good sub for Never a Dull Moment
avis.texte: Origins no longer makes 'Never a Dull Moment' scrub so they recommended this one and I tried it. It was not a good substitute. It does not gently remove the flaky and oily skin the same way that Never a Dull Moment did. It smells... odd. I will not purchase this again.

avis.titre: This is the best exfoliating cleanser I have ever used!
avis.texte: This product is fantastic! A gentle exfoliator I use 3-4 times a week after I cleanse with Checks and Balances foamy cleanser. Follow that up with the Glow Serum and you've got yourself a glowing face in no time! I would recommend this to anyone looking for an exfoliator that works immediately!

Such a great product! I have combo skin and often find myself breaking out. Once I started using this product I've notice a reduction in the amount of breakouts I've had. It's not too rough on the skin and I really love how my skin feels so clean after using it. Already on my third one!

makes my skin so soft! I don't have sensitive skin but I can tell it's probably not for someone who does. but it smells amazing & gets rid of my dry flaky skin! I follow up with their ginzing moisturizer

I don't get the negative reviews at all- I love this stuff and am on my third tube now. It smells great, a little goes a long way. I have very dry skin due to menopause and one use of this makes my skin glow and feel baby smooth. I can't not use this, this is my holy grail of exfoliators.

avis.titre: I love this scrub.  It pairs so well my the cleanser I use.
avis.texte: I use this in the evening when I take off my make-up. It pairs well with my cleanser and I see improvements in my skin.

This scrub is very harsh - although the granules are very fine, they are sharp and it feels like it is scratching my face and my skin hurts after I use it. It is also hard to rinse off and chalky and doesn't feel good to use. I really regret not listening to the other negative reviews of people who had a bad experience with this! I wish I could get my money back. Origins - you used to make a lovely minty face scrub with gentle microbeads that I LOVED - please bring that back - and in a full size (this is tiny and not a good value!)! I have been so disappointed by the Origins products that I love getting discontinued. I really don't understand it.

I actually don't enjoy using this product because it's almost painful to use, and using it on my forehead actually gives me a headache. I've never had that reaction to a scrub before. However my skin is noticeably softer, smoother, and brighter since I started using it. I use it about twice a week.

I have been using the face wash Checks & Balances for years, so I thought this would be a great exfoliator. No, definitely not! It left my skin feeling very strange, like it had a film on it, and it just doesn't exfoliate like Modern Friction. Origins, why have you been discontinuing all of your best products???

Normally I use Modern Friction for exfoliating but I thought I would give this a try to use in conjunction with C&B Frothy Face Wash, which I've been using for years. Nope, nope, nope. Initially, I liked the feel and scent but noticed soon that my face felt dryer, and my skin looked dull. I cut back on usage to a few times a week, and I still was not satisfied so stopped using for a few weeks and went back to MF. Thought I would give it a try again today, and now my skin itches and looks a little rough and red. I'm ditching this and going back to Modern Friction.

I have fair, sensitive skin, which is further sensitized to light due to daily medication I take. I need to be extra careful with the skin care products I use. I love to use a facial scrub 1-2x/week but had trouble finding one for a couple of years since the ones tried all irritated my skin. I was hopeful this one would be different, & it was! It is still a facial scrub, but it is light & non-irritating with a creamy undertone to help my face not feel stripped of its natural moisture. The fragrance of the natural ingredients are uplifting & fresh too. For me, a little bit goes a long way when I use it. "Checks & Balances" is truly a versatile line for any skin types.

I've been searching for a bomb face scrub with the Just the amount of exfoliation to remove my dead, I like the feel the roughness on my skin makes me feel like it's lifting all that dead skin and this is It!! My skin was left super glowing and moisturized!! Thank you Origins for creating such a great product 👌🏽

I haven't been this impressed with a scrub since Modern Friction launched many moons ago. I actually like the Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub better! This combines the micro-exfoliation that made Modern Friction so powerful with everything I loved about the Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash. This was a home run!

I have always had trouble with finding a good exfoliator. They are either too harsh or break me out. I decided to give this a try since I love the checks and balances so much & OMG. This has been a game changer! My skin is glowing like never before, my blackheads are not as noticeable on my nose (which is very hard to do) & it feels amazing on this skin. My husband is also obsessed with this product for the same reasons. Thank you Origins for creating this! I hope to see this in a "Make it Big" size one day !

avis.titre: Just what my summer skin needed!!
avis.texte: My origins regimen was working out so well but when summer hit and my area became more humid my pores were getting congested. This scrub was just what my summer skin needed. I have been using this scrub every other day in the the shower after checks and balances frothy face wash. It really has cleaned out my pours and eliminated my blackheads on my nose which I thought would never happen and I have tried many many products, strips and masks. And my skin is brighter and cleaner looking. One word of caution: when I first used this scrub it actually hurt my face because I was using such a small amount like I would the checks and balances face wash. My theory is the little scrubbers all settle to the bottom of the cap and I got too much scrubbers and not enough of the cream. Now I use more of the product to ensure I get enough of the cream and it no longer feels so abrasive. And like I said I am very happy with the results.

I have sensitive hormonal skin that becomes cystic closer to my period. At first, I thought this was making my skin go through a purging phase to empty my pores and deeply clean…no. This product made me break out even more. It also collects water in the lid if left in the bathtub and gets moldy from the sitting water. Just be careful! My least favorite product. Thank goodness it was a free item.

As I applied the scrub I could feel the grainy texture within the smooth cream. I'm used to products with this texture so that didn't bother me. However, I only had it on about 30 - 40 seconds when it started to burn. Luckily I was in the shower and could rinse it off immediately. After I dried my face it did make my skin feel amazingly soft. I'm torn because the after-the-fact is so good but the burning was unpleasant.
I am so in love with this product. It's changed my life! My face looks clear and pure and since I've started to use it people have told me my skin is glowing!

I've used this a couple times and already I can see a difference on the surface of my skin. It does what it says. I agree it can be harsh if you do not add enough water or rub too hard. This is my preferences though, as I'd rather have an exfoliator that is slightly harsh than one that doesn't do enough. I'm happy with my purchase. I appreciate the natural/light mint scent as I'm sensitive to fragrance.

avis.titre: Great product while the size for the cost is underwhelmin
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this product. You must use very light pressure when using to avoid the polish being too aggressive to your skin, and only apply to very wet skin. The scent is very pleasant and fresh. I will buy again, even as my only criticism is the meager size of the tube. I expected the tube to be similar to the generous size of the modern friction scrub but it's about 2/3 that size. The image is unclear so make sure to note the ounces amount.

I had high expectations from this scrub because it was from Origins, but it fell short. I love the clean ingredients. It smelled great, and felt invigorating on my skin. However, the scrub felt a little more harsh than just gentle compared to other scrubs I've used. My skin felt smooth, but not as smooth as my usual scrub. I've used it a few times and didn't notice any reduction in pore visibility. Did it cleanse my energy and balance my spirit? Probably? *shrugs* Honestly, I love Origins products, but if I didn't know this came from this brand - I probably wouldn't love it as much. The price tag is pretty steep for the results. Overall, I really wanted to love it, but I'm not impressed.
Wow I haven't been this surprised with a face scrub in a very long this. It is amazing especially for my blackheads in certain spots

BzzAgent....every once in a while you introduce me to a new product that will most definitely become a part of my regular routine. Well this product is it. It's a must have from Origins, this Checks & Balances polishing face scrub is absolutely amazing. It's formulated with Bamboo, Silica and Red Tourmaline. The texture is rich and exfoliating, buffing away any dull or dead skin cells and surface impurities, leaving my skin feeing smooth and radiant. Allowing for skin to reached it's polished potential. I currently use this product 3-4xs a week. Adding this product to my current regimen has really proven beneficial. My skin is positively glowing. I currently use this product 3-4xs a week..
This product does it's job well. The scrub helps gets dirt and dead skin off my face. It leaves my face feeling cleaner, clearer, and smooth. The smell isn't bad either.
This scrub definitely left my skin feeling softer and smoother after just one use. It has a nice creamy texture and I didn't find it at all irratting.
I tried it on my face for a couple of days. I loved my skin after that. It left the skin so soft and smooth and renewed.
This product leaves your face feeling cleaning, and is just the right amount of scrub. It exfoliates but is not too harsh, it smells great too!
This face scrub leaves my feeling greasy and gross, ive even started breaking out since I started using it. Would return if i could..

This product is so amazing! I love the smell because it just smells so clean. I also love that it works so well on my face. I have rough textured skin and after I use it my face is so soft and smooth.

Every now and again, I like to treat myself to a more expensive face care item. This is worth it! Maybe it's coincidence but I had a few small pimples on my chin and when I woke up this morning, they were reduced in size. A little of this, goes along way. It's got a nice clean scent and it's got some grit to it. I have sensitive skin, and it didn't irritate my skin in any way. My skin is so soft and smooth! I think this going to be a staple in my skin care routine.
I am really impressed with the Checks and Balances scrub. This product works great and is gentle on the skin. It leaves your skin feeling brand new. Would definately recommend to others

I was not sure what to expect from the product. It did not seem as though it was going to get any dead skin and dry patches off. Was amazed to see that it did in fact do an excellent job at removing these issues. It seems like a cream but once it is spread around you can feel the small granules that will help exfoliate. I would suggest apply a bit directly to the face instead of hands.

From the very first time I used this, my skin felt smoother and softer! I really liked the minty fragrance. It was very refreshing and my pores even seemed to shrink. I would definitely recommend this!

I just loved Origins Polishing Checks and Balances face scrub. I feel so fresh and clean, it smells very nice. You a need a very little amount of this scrub as its very gentle, you need very light fingers pressure. It made my skin very clean, clear and it removed all blackheads and whiteheads around nose area. This is an amazing scrub, it exfoliates skin perfectly. It does add tourmaline in ingredients which gives radiant fresh and healthy looking skin. I loved how amazing it works. I have recommended to my friends and family. This will be a new addition to my skin care routine. Thank you so much Bzzagent for giving me opportunity to try Origins Checks and Balances scrub.
I totally love this scrub. I use it on my face before my morning shower and it removes all the dead skin cells and makes my face bright and glowing.
The first time I used this I could tell the difference right away. This is amazing! It leaves my face feeling very soft and left it not oily as my face usually is.

I really like this scrub. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and does a great job and exfoliating the dead skin and making my face feel super smooth. You don't need a lot, so the small bottle should last awhile. It has a minty scent which is also very pleasant. I would definitely recommend.

I have combination skin and have always struggled to find a scrub wash that could clear up my acne, my skin in on more the oiler side and tend to have sensitive skin. now i had a chance to try the Origins Checks & Balances Scrub face wash and is amazing!! my skin is clean and fresh after using it. is very creamy and foams up very nice so a little goes a long way, It does not dry out my face, really makes my face feel clean, soft and glowing!!! I have not broken out since I started using this, Its in perfect balance and rinses clean. It is easy to use, after cleansing massage into damp skin using a circular motion, rinse and pat dry. I use this product of 3 a 4 times per week. I love it leave my face like baby-soft skin. I highly recommend it for those like me who have oily skin, you will notice the difference.

The Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub left my face feeling super clean and fresh. My skin looks and feels smoother after using this product. It comes in an easy to use tube. I would recommend it to others looking for a face scrub for smoother skin!
I love this product. I have a glow after using this. Lady's please try this product it's worth it!
This is a subtle exfoliant scrub especially if your skin is sensitive. It has a refreshing mint scent & you can feel it working on your face. I could tell a difference after using it a couple times.

I was really hoping to love the Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Facial Scrub because I do really love the brand. However, I am disheartened by my experience with this product after just one use and can definitely never use it again nor recommend it to others. This scrub is extremely intense and abrasive. As soon as I applied it to my skin, I knew that it wasn't going to be good but I powered through for the sake of leaving this review. It has a thick cream consistency with an extremely rough, sandy exfoliant mixed throughout. After feeling how rough this product was, I made sure to be gentle when scrubbing my face with it. I used it for about 30 seconds before I knew it needed to be washed off because my skin could no longer handle it. I do have pretty resilient skin, but this product completely broke down my skin's natural barrier, leaving my face hot and red and causing all of my normal products (serum and moisturizer) to burn and sting - a telltale sign of a damaged skin barrier. I want to note that the last time I exfoliated was 4 days ago, so this is not a result of overexfoliation on my part. I should say that this product does exactly what it says it will do - it sloughs off dead skin cells and surface impurities, buffs the surface of the skin, and helps unclog pores - although not in a way that is safe for your skin. While this product does have many natural plant oils and healthy ingredients, the few bad ingredients overpower the benefits. Unfortunately I will

I love Oringins and checks and balances is my favorite face wash ever. When I learned that there was a Checks and Balances face scrub, I flipped out. I was so lucky I got to try it. It's amazing. Very gentle exfoliant, but super effective. It's great for my sensitive skin. My face has never been so soft!

I LOVE origin products. I was told this was replacingbthe never a dull moment face polisher. I sure hope not. Usually with Origin products my fave looks amazing after one use, with this it was the complete opposite. Maybe a little too harsh for me. I hope they keep never a dull moment

Checks & Balances Polishing Exfoliator Scrub is such a wonderful addition to my bathtime rituals. It is incredibly buttery and whipped in texture. As you spread over your skin, it causes a slight tingling sensation (from the mint essential oil) as you exfoliate with it (which you can do with a light rubbing motion). There is bamboo, mineral silica, and tourmaline in the scrub which does the exfoliating. My skin is left feeling clean, invigorated, and polished. A little goes a long way with this scrub, so this container will last you a while. I highly recommend this product!

I am a regular Modern Friction user. My skin is a little sensitive and I exfoliate 5-6 times a week after sweating at the gym. I tried this, but found the texture very rough. When it started to feel like rubbing sand paper on my skin I mixed it in with Checks and Balances and it became a lot more comfortable to work with. Even though this will not be a regular product for me, I did find that it smoothed my skin immediately. The result reminded me of how my skin feels after using the Original Skin mask.
The smoothness I get from this scrub is completely unmatched. I really love the scent and the fact that it includes tourmaline... *chef's kiss*. I'm in love.
I got to try check balances scrub to try for free from buzz agent to test and review... I love this product it works great.

This face scrub I must say has been really helping me out, it feels like it's very refreshing, as I can feel it when I've applied this to my face, it feels so smoothing, and I feel my skin feels very hydrated and that it really cleans my pores. I'm really enjoying it so far! I received this product as a free sample from BzzAgent.
This is a nice face scrub. It produces nice frothy bubbles, doesn't scrub too harshly, and rinses clean. I will keep this in my rotation of other face scrubs.
Checks and balances Polishing face scrub feels great on my skin it's not to abrasive. The smell isn't to feminine. It leaves my skin smooth and silky.

I have combination, pretty clear skin with some enlarged pores on my cheeks and some congestion in my T Zone, so the perfect exfoliant is a necessity. The exfoliant beads are quite large, compared to other exfoliants I have tried and I feel this causes me to spend a little more time working-in the product. It's like a facial in the shower and leaves your skin smooth with a fresh look throughout the day. Its gentle on my skin and I use it alternate days. I blend it in with circular motions and then leave it for a few minutes before I rinse it out. It leaves me with supple soft skin. It has also helped even out my skin tone which was a bit patchy before I started using it. I like the concept and truly think the Origins Checks and Balances scrub is an excellent product!
This scrub is one of my absolute favorites! I love using it and my skin feels so soft afterwards. Can be kind of drying like any exfoliator so definitely moisturize afterwards! Love it though

This scrub can be very rough on the skin so make sure to dispense a good amount and use a very gentle force. It can burn a little if you scrub too hard! It does a very good job exfoliating and always leaves my skin silky smooth. It has a long list of ingredients including many plant oils.

avis.titre: Great for removing texture on face
avis.texte: This face scrub does exactly what it says it does. It let my face feeling perfectly smooth and texture free. And it does this without being to hard and making your skin feel like you just took a Brillo pad to it. My face felt great and refreshed after using it and looks great too! It's pleasant to use and had a gentle smell and feel.
I love the smell and the way my skin felt afterwards. I feel so fresh and clean. My skin has a spectacular glow now. This product is great, and I will recommend to friends!
i like this face scrub, gentle on face, beads are not too big. has no smell (smells neutral/slightly minty). cute packaging
This is a great scrub but is gentle at the same time. Even on my sensitive skin, it still worked great. I didn't aggravate my skin as many things usually do. I would use it again in the future.
The scent is phenomenal, and the exfoliation is definitely on point! It seemed a bit abrasive at first but that was due to user error, now I'm obsessed!
I like the scrub itself but it was not good for sensitive skin. It felt like it burned.
I loved using this face scrub! Not only does it feel great on my skin, but it leaves a lovely glowy, polish feel after words!
This facial scrub is super soft and leaves my skin feeling really clean. Not overly rough like some other scrubs on the market.

avis.titre: Easy to use a got great results
avis.texte: I have tried Origin products in the pass and have been very happy with all that I tried. But this is the first time I have used Origins Checks and Balance Polishing Facial Scrub.. This white scrub is "toothpaste"thick and when applied as directed to a damp face it thinned itself, so it was easy to massage .Like a lot of this kind of products ,it feels a little "gritty when applied "to your face.. this is what " polishes "removing dirt and and helping to unclog your pores. It was easy to rinse ,leaving no residue just smoother skin.,softer and even appears brighter after a week of using. No signs of redness or irritation to my sometime sensitive skin. I did use my moisturizer as usual at night (my normal routine )Recommend to family and friends

avis.titre: One of the best scrubs I have ever tried
avis.texte: The first thing that surprised me was the size of the product. It was a lot more than I expected which left me pleasantly surprised. The second thing was the packaging really nice tones of green and white. I really liked the smell, it is soft and subtle but it is there and I really appreciate that so my skin is not covered in different smells. The scrubbing was good and easy, it had just the right amount to give a scrubbing effect and it didn't leave my face red or with marks like scratched after I was done using it. I also had no bad reactions to it, like allergic reactions. I little bit goes a long way which I like since I get to keep this product around for long. All in all really good and I recommend
I liked this product for it's gentle scrub and leaving my skin feel clean and smooth! I like the scent as well, it's light and not too overwhelming. Will continue to use this product!

This Checks & Balances Scrub is very effective. It is very gentle to my dry skin. It exfoliates the skin and leaves a soft clean skin. The pores looks smaller and less noticeable. My skin feels calm and smooth. I also like the scent of the product. It has light refreshing mint scent.

Leavesyour skin feeling soft as a babies bottom! It's a medium to coarse feel so be aware it isn't gentle but it gets the job done. My only problem would be the heavy mint scent... it's like toothpaste!
Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub is an amazing product. I loved how it made my skin feel while using and after. I would purchase again and I would recommend this product.

My skin was so smooth and soft after using this! It was somewhat abrasive and really gritty during use but my results were undeniable. The mint scent also was somewhat toothpaste smelling but it wasn't overpowering. I'm looking forward to continuing to use and definitely recommend!
This smells great and leaves skin soft after use. It did make my face a little red but that went away after a little while.
